title: Code of Conduct
content:
Kartik Corp — Code of Conduct
The Code of Conduct defines the ethical and professional standards expected from all
employees.
Employees must:
● Treat colleagues respectfully.
● Maintain professionalism.
● Avoid disruptive or inappropriate conduct
● Support an inclusive workplace.
Workplace Harassment
Kartik Corp maintains a zero-tolerance approach toward:
● Harassment
● Discrimination
● Bullying
● Retaliation
Any incidents should be reported to HR immediately.
Confidentiality
Employees must protect:
● Company information
● Client information
● Financial data
● Employee records
● Intellectual property
Conflict of Interest - Employees must avoid activities that conflict with company interests.
IT and System Usage
Company systems must not be used for:
● Illegal activities
● Unauthorized software download
● Sharing offensive material
● Security violations
● Social Media Conduct
Reporting Violations - Employees should report policy violations or unethical behavior to HR or
management.
Disciplinary Action - Violation of the Code of Conduct may result in disciplinary action, including
termination of employment.

title: Employee Onboarding Policy
content:
Kartik Corp — Employee Onboarding Policy
Pre-Joining Process
● Before joining, the HR team will:
● Issue the offer letter and appointment letter.
● Share onboarding schedules.
● Provide IT and system access requirements.
● Verify educational and employment documents.
Joining Day Activities
● On the first day of employment, employees will:
● Attend the company induction session.
● Meet their reporting manager and team.
● Receive ID cards and system credentials.
● Review HR policies and compliance guidelines.
Documentation Required
Employees must submit:
● Government-issued ID proof
● Address proof
● Academic certificates
● PAN card and Aadhaar card
● Bank account details
● Passport-sized photographs
Probation Period
● All employees undergo a probation period of 6 months.
● Performance and conduct are reviewed during probation.
● Employment confirmation is based on satisfactory performance
Training and Orientation
New employees will receive:
● Department-specific training
● HR policy orientation
● Information security awareness training
● Workplace ethics training
● System and software access guidance
Buddy / Mentor Program - Employees may be assigned a buddy or mentor to support them
during the onboarding period.
Employee Responsibilities
Employees are expected to:
● Complete mandatory onboarding modules.
● Adhere to company policies.
● Maintain professional conduct.
● Protect confidential company information.

title: HR Manual
content:
Kartik Corp — HR Manual
Introduction - The HR Manual provides guidance regarding employee policies, workplace
practices, and organizational expectations.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Kartik Corp is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination
based on gender, religion, disability, age, or background.
Working Hours
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
Employees are expected to complete assigned responsibilities within scheduled hours.
Attendance Policy
Employees must mark attendance through approved systems.
Repeated late attendance may result in corrective action.
Dress Code
Employees are expected to maintain professional and workplace-appropriate attire.
Workplace Safety
Employees must follow all workplace safety guidelines and report hazards immediately.
Information Security
Employees must:
Use strong passwords.
Protect company devices.
Avoid unauthorized data sharing.
Follow cybersecurity guidelines.
Remote Work Expectations
Employees working remotely must:
Maintain availability during working hours.
Ensure secure internet access.
Attend meetings regularly.
Meet productivity expectations.
Performance Management
Performance reviews are conducted periodically to assess:
Goal achievement
Productivity
Team collaboration
Professional development
Training and Development
Employees are encouraged to continuously improve professional skills through learning
programs.
Separation and Exit Process
Employees resigning from the organization must:
Serve applicable notice periods.
Return company assets.
Complete exit formalities.
HR Contact Information
For HR support, employees may contact:
Email: kartik111102@gmail.com
HR Helpdesk: +91-9910720375

title: Kartik Corp — Employee Benefits Handbook
content:
Kartik Corp — Employee Benefits Handbook
Health Insurance
● Employees are covered under the company health insurance plan.
● Coverage includes hospitalization, emergency treatment, and selected outpatient
services.
● Dependents may be included as per policy terms.
Life Insurance - Kartik Corp provides group life insurance coverage to eligible employees.
● Provident Fund (PF)
● PF contributions are made in accordance with applicable laws.
● Both employer and employee contributions are deposited monthly.
Gratuity - Employees completing 5 years of continuous service are eligible for gratuity benefits
as per applicable law.
Flexible Work Options - 3 days work from office and 2 days work from Home
Learning and Development
● Employees are encouraged to participate in:
● Internal training sessions
● Certification programs
● Leadership development workshops
● Skill enhancement programs
Employee Wellness Programs
● The company supports employee wellbeing through:
● Wellness sessions
● Mental health support initiatives
● Employee engagement activities
● Fitness and awareness programs
Travel Reimbursement - Employees traveling for business purposes may claim reimbursement
for approved expenses.
Performance Bonus - Eligible employees may receive performance-based bonuses depending
on business and individual performance.
Rewards and Recognition
● Kartik Corp recognizes employees through:
● Spot awards
● Quarterly recognition programs
● Long-service awards
● Performance appreciation programs
Employee Assistance
● Employees may contact HR for support regarding
● Workplace concerns
● Benefits clarification
● Conflict resolution
● Career development guidance

title: Annual Leave Policy 2026
content:
Kartik Corp — Employee Leave Policy
1. Casual Leave (CL)
● Employees are entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave per calendar year.
● Casual Leave may be used for personal work, emergencies, or short breaks.
● Maximum 3 consecutive days may be taken at a time unless approved by the reporting
manager.
● Unused Casual Leave cannot be carried forward to the next year.
2. Sick Leave (SL)
● Employees are entitled to 10 days of Sick Leave annually.
● Sick Leave may be used in case of illness, injury, or medical appointments.
● A medical certificate may be requested for leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.
3. Earned / Annual Leave (EL)
● Employees receive 18 days of Earned Leave per year.
● Earned Leave can be planned for vacations, travel, or personal commitments.
● Leave requests should ideally be submitted at least 7 days in advance.
● Up to 30 unused Earned Leave days may be carried forward.
4. Maternity Leave
● Female employees are eligible for 26 weeks of paid maternity leave as per applicable
law.
● Maternity leave may begin up to 8 weeks before the expected delivery date.
● Additional unpaid leave may be considered based on medical recommendations and
management approval.
5. Paternity Leave
● Male employees are eligible for 10 working days of paid paternity leave.
● Leave must be availed within 6 months of childbirth.
6. Bereavement Leave
Employees may take up to 5 working days of bereavement leave in the event of the death of an
immediate family member.
Kartik Corp observes national holidays and company-declared holidays each calendar year.
8. Leave Approval Process
● All leave requests must be submitted through the HRMS portal.
● Approval from the reporting manager is mandatory.
● Emergency leave should be informed through email or phone as soon as possible.
9. Unauthorized Absence
Absence without approval or notification may lead to salary deduction and disciplinary action.
10. Policy Amendments
Kartik Corp reserves the right to revise this policy at any time based on business and legal
requirements.
